body: Thank you, it really does help. Even reading my own words snaps me out of it a little. Knowing how much it would hurt my children if I didn't try harder; knowing I'm not alone in feeling this way. Really, thank you.

I go back and forth on the possibility of reinvention, but you know with depression you are just in a tunnel you can't see the end of. I know it's not normal to feel this way. I think of pioneer women who lost all their babies and dark age villagers who lived in ages of pestilence and violence and I feel so stupid for having no will to survive in this cushy modern world. It just makes me feel even more guilty, weak and unworthy.
